messages.subject: Extracting values from smoothed line
parts:
Hi all,

I'm trying to extract y values for all integer values of x that are present on a smoothed plot. I have a plot of size vs age and I am trying to figure out what age individuals are at each whole number size. I've tried running the following code:

vonbertgrowth <- function(ta,t0,Linf,k){
  Lt <- data.frame(size = NA, age = NA)
  for (i in 1:ta){
    Lt[i,1] <- Linf * (1-exp(-k*(i-t0)))
  }
  Lt$age <- 1:ta
  return(Lt)
}

blueRockfish_vbg_f <- vonbertgrowth(ta=50,t0=-1.145,Linf=38.150142,k=0.172)


ggplot(data = blueRockfish_vbg_f, aes(y = age, x = size)) +
  geom_smooth()

smooth_vals <- predict(loess(blueRockfish_vbg_f$age ~ blueRockfish_vbg_f$size), data = blueRockfish_vbg_f)

It outputs the following plot:



The problem is that smooth_vals ends up being a vector length of 50. Since size only goes up to ~48, I know that it isn't counting integer values of size. Additionally, when I change the input value of 'ta' for the vonbertgrowth() function, the length of smooth_vals changes to match. So I think that smooth_vals is predicting for integer values of age. How do I get it t predict for size?

Thanks for the help,
David

I think that you're looking for ggplot_build(). 

You essentially want to get at the information that was used to build your ggplot, right?

I don't have time to write more, but here's a great SO post on this topic: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/9789871/method-to-extract-stat-smooth-line-fit
